abilities.name: Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency
_curatorNotes: Shield effect authored 2026-07-12: Optical Flow Shield Barrier, target 'active', onCast skill trigger, 20s duration (refresh — recasting E replaces/recreates the barrier). Scaling stat is ATK, NOT HP — gcsim shield.go addShield: shieldHP = shieldAtk[lvl]*c.TotalAtk() + shieldFlat[lvl]. Values at talent level 10 (index 9): shieldAtk[9]=3.981312 → 398.13% ATK, shieldFlat[9]=3050.9182 → 3050.92 flat (ineffa_gen.go); sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '398.1% ATK+3051'. Target 'active' from gcsim shield Tmpl Target:-1 (player-wide barrier, follows active char per existing summon mobility:follows). 250% Electro DMG Absorption effectiveness still not modelled (no per-element shield-strength primitive).
Skill cast: AoE Electro at skillHitmark=26f, 155.52% ATK Electro elemental art. 1 Electro particle per cast (0.3s ICD, 66% chance per discharge).

Two summons: (1) Optical Flow Shield Barrier — 20s, addShield called at +4f from cast; mobility:follows (shield travels with active char). HP=shieldAtk[lvl=10]×ATK + shieldFlat[lvl=10] = 398.13% ATK + 3050.92 flat. Absorbs Electro DMG at 250% effectiveness (not modelled — schema has no shield-strength field). (2) Birgitta — 20s, summonBirgitta at +68f from cast (skillHitmark+42); mobility:stationary, placed on primary target.

Birgitta discharge: firstTickDelay=0.7s (42f after spawn), interval~2s (119f, 1.983s rounded). Mult = skillDoT[lvl=10] = 172.8% ATK Electro per tick. AttackTagElementalArt, ICDTagNone — count as elemental art DMG.
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, 16*60, 1) — 16s cooldown from frame 1.
Frames: skillFrames=InitAbilSlice(32), only ActionSwap=31 explicitly set; other actions default to animLen=32. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J authored at the available values.

↻ 2026-08-14 — the stand-in summon is retired. "Optical Flow Shield Barrier" was a zero-effect `summons[]` entry whose only jobs were to give this instant cast a 20s active window and to put a labelled bar on the chart. Both now have their own field: `activeDuration` on the ability and `label` on the shield Effect, which the shield lane renders. `summons[]` is back to meaning a thing left in the world. Bar geometry is unchanged apart from the spawn offset, which the shield window never had.
abilities.description:
Ineffa engages her Enhanced Cleaning Module, dealing a single instance of AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents, activating her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, and summoning the Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, **Birgitta**.
The Optical Flow Shield Barrier absorbs DMG based on Ineffa's ATK, and it will absorb Electro DMG with 250% effectiveness.

abilities.name: Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator
abilities.caveat: Already-active Birgitta is re-summoned at the new spot with her duration reset in game, but the timeline shows a second overlapping bar. Read overlap within 20s as one Birgitta, not two.
_curatorNotes: Burst hit at hitmark=111f from cast: 1218.24% ATK Electro AoE elemental burst. summonBirgitta also fires at hitmark=111f.
Burst frames: burstFrames=InitAbilSlice(127), ActionSkill=127 ActionDash=105 ActionJump=106 ActionWalk=130 ActionSwap=126. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 15*60). ConsumeEnergy(4) drains 4 energy from teammates; not modelled.

Birgitta authored as a separate summon on the burst — discharge effect identical to skill-summoned Birgitta. In-game the burst RESETS the existing Birgitta's duration rather than spawning a second; the planner over-spawns when E and Q overlap. Trade-off documented in caveat.
abilities.description:
Through Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, **Birgitta**, Ineffa can use Rocket Punches to quickly clean up opponents! Shoots Birgitta into the fray, dealing AoE Electro DMG and allowing Birgitta to remain on the field.

If Birgitta is already on the field, having been summoned by Ineffa, this Skill will re-summon Birgitta at the target's location and reset her duration.

passives.name: Overclocking Circuit
_curatorNotes: A1 fires an extra 65% ATK Lunar-Charged Electro hit on each Birgitta discharge IF a Lunar-Charged thundercloud is currently active (reactable.LcKey duration > 0). Modelling would require a conditional summonTick effect (gated on a global team reaction-state) — schema lacks runtime-reaction-state primitive. Damage effect not authored; flagged.
The damage component is also Lunar-Charged-tagged, which Ineffa's lunarchargeInit base DMG bonus (+0.7% per 100 ATK, max +14%) augments — same Lunar-Charged-base-DMG schema gap as Flins.
passives.description: If there are thunderclouds created by Lunar-Charged reactions nearby when **Birgitta** unleashes Discharge attacks, she will initiate an additional attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 65% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.

passives.name: Panoramic Permutation Protocol
_curatorNotes: Parameter Permutation: on Q cast, 20s buff granting EM = 6% Ineffa's ATK to Ineffa AND active char (per gcsim a4Init: applies if char.Index() == active OR char.Index() == self). Modelled as scaling-form BuffValue (6% ATK→EM) with target=['self','active'], onCast burst trigger, duration 20s. Active-target segmentation will cut the bar per swap as expected.

Original stub authored two effects (em + atk%) targeting team — incorrect. Replaced with single em effect targeting self+active per gcsim source. Description says 'all party members' but gcsim restricts to active+self — going with gcsim.
The 'atk%' line in genshin-db description appears to be wiki-inaccurate; gcsim only applies the EM portion. If KQM clarifies otherwise, add a second effect.
passives.description: When using the Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator**, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.

Value is `unknown` form because the planner doesn't track Ineffa's runtime ATK. Trigger keyed on E cast — barrier activation is implicit in the E cast for canonical rotations.
constellations.description: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.

constellations.name: Support Cleaning Module
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Punishment Edict — on Q hit, a marked enemy detonates after a delay (or on death) for 300% ATK Lunar-Charged Electro AoE. Trigger is enemy-death OR after-fixed-delay; schema doesn't have an enemy-death trigger primitive. The fixed-delay path could be authored as an afterDuration-style effect on the burst, but the proper gating on enemy-presence isn't modelable. Not authored. (2) Q grants nearby party Optical Flow Shield Barriers — team-wide shielding niche; not represented in the planner. Not authored.
constellations.description:
After the Elemental Burst **Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator** hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Additionally, when the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.

constellations.name: A Dawning Morn for You
_curatorNotes: C6: when Ineffa has Carrier Flow Composite (c1Key active) AND a team Lunar-Charged proc fires, deal 135% ATK Lunar-Charged Electro AoE on Ineffa's location, 3.5s ICD (c6Init: c6IcdKey 3.5*60). Authored as a damage effect with onReaction:lunarCharged + procCooldown:3.5. It cannot gate on Carrier Flow Composite (no schema for tracking the C1 status). Flagged in caveat.

⚠️⚠️ 2026-08-18 — READ THIS BEFORE BELIEVING THE EFFECT IS LIVE. The note above reads as though the damage fires and only the C1 gating is missing. It does not fire at all, for TWO independent reasons, and the missing gate is the least of them. (1) NO `application[]`: `procEffects` in src/lib/sim/procs.ts is the one acceptance rule for a proc, and it drops any damage effect whose `application` is absent or empty — so this effect never reaches the proc registry, never emits an application, never draws a marker, and `damage` maps to no Team Builder capability either. It is one of the 17 application-less damage procs in the corpus, against 13 that work. (2) `lunarCharged` IS NEVER EMITTED: src/lib/sim/reactionBridge.ts states it explicitly ("shatter, lunarBloom, lunarCharged and stellarSwirl stay unemitted"), so even with an `application[]` the trigger has nothing to listen to. ⛔ Do not author `application[]` here expecting the effect to come alive — fixing (1) alone changes nothing while (2) stands.

⏭ Work-item shape, in order: lunarCharged has to become a reaction the gauge EMITS (reactionBridge is the one place that knows both vocabularies — it already applies lunarCrystallize and stellarConduct, which is the precedent to copy) BEFORE an `application[]` on this effect buys anything. The C1 gating is a third, separate blocker: procs are gated by authored `conditions`, and there is still no condition that says "Carrier Flow Composite is active on Ineffa". The caveat stays accurate throughout.
[A7] The C1 buff referenced in the C6 gating caveat is named Carrier Flow Composite (rendered as 'the C1 buff' for compression).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — This is an off-field damage proc with no `application[]`, so the proc registry rejects it (rubric P3/D10) — there is no bar, no marker, no tick and no lane where a reader would look for it. It is also keyed to `lunarCharged`, which the gauge never emits (N12), so no Lunar-Charged marker draws either; the absence has no shape on screen. Constellation-gated on top, so it only ever reaches a C6 reader. The engineering truth belongs in the (already thorough) `_curatorNotes`, not in the 262px column. Category: invisible-omission.

This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.
